Name: Romanceable Rasmodia - Female Wizard
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hrvj6SP/Romanceable-Rasmodia-Logo.png[/img]

[center][b][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]Tired of the old man in the tower?
This mod fully transforms the Wizard Magnus into his female version
The Witch Rasmodia[/font][/size][/b][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Contents[/b]:[/size][/font]
[list]
[*]The old Wizard is now Witch Rasmodia[/*]
[*]Dialogues from the base game, Stardew Valley Expanded, Romanceable Rasmodius and many other mods adjusted to the correct gender and name[/*]
[*]Corrected events, quests, special orders and more[/*]
[*]New portrait and sprite (now with beach outfit)[/*]
[/list]

Despite what the name of the mod claims, base Rasmodia is not romanceable. This whole mod is basically a modular compatibility patch for whatever mods you already have and focuses on changing dialogue, text and some animations to fit with gender change (the only exception at the moment is resort event mentioned below).

[center][size=5][b]As a result Rasmodia is [color=#ff0000]only romanceable[/color] with either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url] [color=#ff0000]OR (and I emphasize... OR, not and)  [/color]non-SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607][b]Romanceable Rasmodius[/b][/url]![/b][/size][/center]


[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=4]Config:[/size][/b][/font]
[spoiler]
"Portrait Style": Original - new style, CreepyKat - old, Nyapu - needs no introduction
"Character Style": Original - same old, Dacar's - SCA inspired
"Portrait Hat Toggle": Enabled - Regular portraits with a hat, Disabled - Hat disabled for all portraits, Beach Only - Hat disabled for beach portrait only ([b]WORKS ONLY WITH DACAR'S AND NYAPU'S STYLE PORTRAITS![/b])
"Character Hat Toggle": Enabled - Regular sprites with a hat, Disabled - Hat disabled for all sprites, Beach Only - Hat disabled for beach sprite only
"Nose Overlay Toggle": If disabled Rasmodia gets her nose stolen once again (she didn't have one for years and I didn't notice...) [default: true]
"Name change hearts": Configurable amount of hearts required for "Witch" to become "Rasmodia" [default: 4]
"SCA Overwrite": Overwrites appearances added by Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, mods adding seasonal outfits should for Rasmodia should either use the new appearance system and set Rasmodia as a false dependency or ask users to disable this config in case of overwrites. [default: true][/spoiler]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=4]Resort event:[/size][/b][/font]
How to unlock:
[spoiler]
- You must be married to Rasmodia
- Island resort needs to be renovated
- There's a 20% chance each day you'll get a letter from Rasmodia about a surprise
- Visit the resort on a sunny Saturday or Sunday[/spoiler]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Translations:[/b][/size][/font]
Before you post new translations please DM me or ask in the comments. I'd rather avoid multiple translations for the same language in case existing one still works. AI translations are not allowed, since many things can't be translated literally.

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Regarding compatibility:[/b][/size][/font]
I always greatly appreciate when authors add compatibility for Rasmodia on their side (since it's often way simpler and easier to maintain). If you are one of such authors, please let me know so I can thank you and check out your mod! And if you are an author who wants to add compatibility (but isn't sure how or just is too busy), you can feel free to DM me here or on Stardew Valley discord. I'm always happy to help!
